summary.text: Nicole Miller is a Republican member of the Oklahoma House of Representatives who has represented District 82 since 2018 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Nicole Miller took office on November 21, 2018, succeeding Kevin Calvey.
Travis Headd, a Democrat, is her opponent in the November 3, 2026 general election.
